name: Seedance 2.0 Mini Image To Video
description: Seedance 2.0 Mini Image To Video is available in the Business API catalog.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Video length in seconds (4-15), or 'auto' to let the model choose.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

bitrate_mode.description: Output encode bitrate. 'high' produces a larger, higher-bitrate file; defaults to 'standard'.
bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode

image_url.description: URL of the starting-frame image to animate.
image_url.title: Image Url

end_image_url.description: Optional URL of the image to use as the last frame.
end_image_url.title: End Image Url
